name: Pocket Network

overview.text: Pocket Network presents data services that developers publish and agents pay to call, alongside public RPC access. Its homepage advertises 120 services, including rule-based address normalization and named-entity recognition as well as model-based reranking. Developers are offered service registration, supplier setup, testing and an acceptance audit, with prices set in compute units per request and on-chain metering described at a stable dollar value. Callers use HTTPS endpoints paid per call through x402 or MPP. These are product terms, not verified demand, earnings or professional validation of every listed service.
